cells.scene: A traveler receives a train ticket at a counter while a simple calendar shows the journey date several page turns ahead; ticket bought before the journey.
A tall stone archway with a rounded top forms an entrance through a garden wall, path continuing underneath.
A responsible adult politely but firmly gestures for a worker to stop using a noisy drill near a peaceful building, concerned conversational posture.
An adult with a wry raised eyebrow stands soaked under a broken umbrella in pouring rain, ironic smiling reaction, no speech text.

prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE SQUARE 2x2 atlas with four equal square cells for an adult vocabulary app. Attached image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: restrained ink-and-watercolor educational illustrations, clear dark blue-charcoal outlines, pale blue wash, small warm natural color accents. Pure WHITE opaque background. Central 75% of each quadrant contains its subject with generous margins. Nothing crosses midlines. Leave horizontal 45–55% and vertical 47–53% center bands EMPTY WHITE. Natural human anatomy, recognizable objects, clear 320px silhouettes, restrained detail, no elaborate environment. NO captions, labels, writing, borders, grid lines, watermarks or logos. Only symbols or numerals explicitly requested in a cell are allowed. Meanings are guidance; never write them. Row-major fixed order. FOUR CELLS:
TOP LEFT — advance (a.预先的，事先获得的): A traveler receives a train ticket at a counter while a simple calendar shows the journey date several page turns ahead; ticket bought before the journey.
TOP RIGHT — archway (n.拱形门楼): A tall stone archway with a rounded top forms an entrance through a garden wall, path continuing underneath.
BOTTOM LEFT — remonstrate (v.规劝，告诫): A responsible adult politely but firmly gestures for a worker to stop using a noisy drill near a peaceful building, concerned conversational posture.
BOTTOM RIGHT — ironically (ad.讽刺地): An adult with a wry raised eyebrow stands soaked under a broken umbrella in pouring rain, ironic smiling reaction, no speech text.
EXTRA CROP SAFETY: Draw noticeably SMALLER compact subjects. Every object, mast, roof, thought bubble and entire person must have an empty white border of at least 12% of its quadrant on ALL FOUR sides. Top row ends above 44% canvas height; bottom row starts below 58%. Never let a background tower extend upward into the midline. No part is clipped by a quadrant edge.
review_notes: Four scenes match course meanings and passed anatomy/crop review. Advance is a ticket bought before the journey; remonstrate is a firm polite warning; ironically shows a wry response to a broken umbrella.
